title: chore(ui): raise the eager ui-components ceiling by 8,000 bytes on maintainer ruling
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuWrubarDyy1TAMVqK1ZWbAY)_

repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgWSAwkSz6F3eit2Y9u

Refs #36023

Area: b1-L · budget-only, no card of its own. **Authorisation: maintainer ruling 7063116595 on #36023** (option B on the seat's decision card, chosen 2026-11-21T13:12Z: raise the eager `ui-components` budget by about 8 KB, with headroom, in its own budget-only PR).

## What changes

One file, `ui/scripts/check-eager-closure-budget.mjs`, constants and their comments only:

| constant | before | after |
|---|---:|---:|
| `PER_CHUNK_GZIP_CEILINGS['ui-components']` | 347,000 | 355,000 |
| `PER_CHUNK_BASELINE['ui-components']` | 265,937 | 273,937 |

The ceiling and its baseline move together by the same +8,000, which keeps the ceiling-minus-baseline gap (81,063) the way objectstack#28124 did for `i18n-locale-en`. A dated "⚠️ RAISED ... ON EXPLICIT MAINTAINER RULING" entry on the key carries the rows below and what the bytes buy. No code change, #36039 is not touched, no exemption added, no import made lazy. Not moved: `MAX_EAGER_CLOSURE_GZIP_BYTES`, `BASELINE`, `REGRESSION_THIS_GATE_MUST_CATCH_BYTES`, the other three per-chunk rows.

## Why

`main` sits 104 bytes under the old line, so S5 #36039 (the form's line-item grid cells) is ejected from the merge queue on it, and so would the next form-field PR be.

### The rows (one container, one instrument)

`CI=true pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/console...`, reading `apps/console/dist/eager-closure.json`, twice on one tree: `main` at `78f7160e` alone, then that `main` with #36039's head `fbbaaa99` merged in (`a31a993e`, local, not pushed). Gzipped bytes:

| chunk | `78f7160e` | `a31a993e` | delta |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| `vendor-objectstack` | 671,638 | 671,638 | 0 |
| `i18n-locale-en` | 65,749 | 65,749 | 0 |
| `framework` | 88,339 | 88,339 | 0 |
| `ui-components` | 346,896 | 349,448 | **+2,552** |
| aggregate | 2,028,610 | 2,031,144 | +2,534 |

The same 104 eager chunks by name in both builds; besides `ui-components` only `src` moved by more than 4 bytes (+19). Raw minified `ui-components`: 1,292,123 -> 1,299,070 (+6,947). (The S5 thread measured +2,679 on an older main, `7ba22bb6`; `main` has since drifted +5.4 KB in this chunk, which is why it now sits 104 bytes under the line on its own.)

### What the bytes buy

- +2,552: the line-item grid's in-cell option and date panels (`GridSelectCell`, `GridDateCell`) and its pop-out text input (`GrowingCellInput`), so a form's line items edit in the cell as a list grid does.
- About 5.4 KB of shared headroom once S5 lands (355,000 − 349,448 = 5,552), so the next form-field PR does not bounce at once. Not a budget for a new component group. Per the ruling, a follow-up card takes GridField out of the eager chunk (it is `import()`ed but also statically exported from `packages/fields/src/index.tsx`), after which both numbers come back down together.

## Verification

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

- `pnpm --dir ui run check:eager-closure` on the merged tree (`a31a993e` build, this branch's constants): exit 0; `ui-components` 341.3 KB / 346.7 KB ceiling, headroom 5.4 KB; aggregate, membership and sensitivity halves all ✅.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/__tests__/check-eager-closure-budget.test.ts`: 174/174 passed (ceiling > baseline, gap < 695 KiB).
- `node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --branch HEAD`: NOT governed, ordinary queue landing.
- `dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` (16 commands for this file list), each `:: exit 0`: check-closing-keyword-parity (+ `--self-test`), check-comment-mask-corpus, `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`, check:adr-anchors, check:driver-memory-census, check:gitlink-declared, check:nul-bytes, check:pm-expected-skips, check:published-files, check:refd-timer-probe, check:registry-log-declared, check:rest-log-spy-declared, check:tier-file-adoption, check:undeclared-dep-imports, check:watch-hint-literal.
- `skip-changeset`: the only file is under `ui/scripts/`, owned by the private root package `object-ui-monorepo`, so the diff publishes nothing from any released package (AGENTS.md Post-Task Checklist step 3).

Branch is the harness-assigned `claude/project-thread-usk9vf`, not `claude/issue-<n>-…` (no card of its own).
